description: Eastern Province - By-Laws relating to the Pothuvil Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of new by-laws (specifically "By-laws Relating to Advertisements") for the Pottuvil Pradeshiya Sabha. It establishes a regulatory framework for controlling, supervising, and regularizing advertisements within the local government area, including licensing requirements, fee structures, and compliance rules. This fits Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory) as it creates new subsidiary legislation and regulatory requirements rather than focusing on government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
